verdict.rationale: The docs site serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json) and documents the HTTP query endpoint, which makes an API reference plausible. The quickstart also walks users through running a generated JSON request against a local instance, which gives runnable examples outside a reference UI. However, no evidence shows an interactive API explorer or playground where examples can be run from the reference itself. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive in-browser API reference or playground, runnable examples embedded in the reference pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
